faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting organization for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Bidhan Chandra Krishi Viswavidyalaya (BCKV) for research positions located in Mohanpur, West Bengal.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised in BCKV Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The advertised post is Project Associate-I under advertisement number DR/S-1891(GOI)/26/699 on a temporary research basis.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for Project Associate-I?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Project Associate-I post under this specific recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required educational qualification for Project Associate-I?
faq.answer: Candidates need an M.Sc. or M.Tech. in Remote Sensing & GIS/Geoinformatics with a B.Sc. in Agriculture/Geography/Physics, or an M.Tech. in Data Science or Computer Science.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary or stipend offered for this position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive Rs. 31,000/- plus HRA per month for the first and second years, and Rs. 35,000/- plus 27% HRA per month for the third year.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for BCKV Project Associate-I?
faq.answer: The application mode is offline. Eligible candidates must send their filled applications in plain paper to the Principal Investigator of the project.

faq.question: Q7. What is the last date to submit the offline application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the completed offline application form is 4 October 2026 (positively within 10 days of notification issuance).

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee required for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification, meaning candidates can submit their applications without any payment.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for the BCKV Project Associate-I post?
faq.answer: The selection of candidates will be conducted through a personal interview by the designated Selection Committee.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official website to download the application form?
faq.answer: You can visit the official Bidhan Chandra Krishi Viswavidyalaya website at www.bckv.edu.in to download the application form and notification.
